title: MOTION (PRICE - YAROSLAVSKY) relative to funding for community subsidies for special events in Council District 9.
text:
[Council File 26-1624; CDs 9, 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (PRICE - YAROSLAVSKY) relative to funding for community subsidies for special events in Council District 9.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $8,390.68 from the General City Purposes Fund No. 100/56, Account No. 000866 (Council District 9 Council Fee Subsidy Account) AND $8,390 from the Council District 9 portion of the Council Project line item in the General City Purposes Fund No. 100/56, Account No. 000A28 [TOTAL:
$16,780.68] to the Bureau of Street Services Transaction Fund No. 64C/50, Revenue Source Code No. 4658 (Special Events) for community subsidies for special events in Council District 9.
2. AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Street Services to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
